headline: UPDATE: Nifty, Bank Nifty reverse from opening spike (Nifty hit 24,703.90), slide to session lows into midday
gist: Nifty -1.04% at 24,517.60 (day range 24,496.70-24,703.90), below VWAP 24,579.07, testing demand near 24,506-24,524 after fading from the day's opening high. Bank Nifty -1.18% at 57,561.80 (range 57,487.05-58,068.95), near its day low, as caution builds into Wed's RBI verdict.

headline: Sensex holds up far better than Nifty/Bank Nifty amid the midday slide
gist: Sensex -0.20% at 78,483.40 (day range 78,429.12-79,143.15), below VWAP 78,684.98 but well off the -1.04%/-1.18% declines in Nifty/Bank Nifty — a notable divergence, likely reflecting lighter weighting toward the hardest-hit financial names.

headline: RBI's 3-day MPC concludes Wednesday 10am; consensus sees repo rate held at 5.25% for 4th straight meeting
gist: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra to announce the MPC decision Wed 10am IST, followed by a 12pm press conference. Consensus (Business Standard poll) expects the repo rate held at 5.25%; India's 10Y yield steady near 6.7%, signalling bond traders aren't pricing an imminent change.

headline: UPDATE: Nifty extends slide, breaks below 24,506-24,524 demand zone flagged at midday, fresh low
gist: Nifty -1.17% at 24,484.8 (session low 24,474.1), below VWAP 24,561.5, breaking through the 24,506-24,524 demand zone flagged in the 12:25 brief as RBI-eve caution deepens.

headline: UPDATE: Bank Nifty slides to fresh session low as financials continue to lead the broader decline
gist: Bank Nifty -1.38% at 57,446.6, fresh session low 57,426.6, below VWAP 57,658.6, extending its underperformance versus Nifty into the RBI verdict.

headline: UPDATE: Silver extends rally to fresh session high $59.40 (+2.35%), sharply outpacing gold's +0.73% gain
gist: Silver $59.22 (+2.35%), fresh session high $59.395, above VWAP $59.18; demand zone 58.97-59.06 defended twice. Gold $4,120.40 (+0.73%), above VWAP, upper third of range. Both extending Monday's dollar-softness driven gains.

headline: Sensex still holding up far better than Nifty/Bank Nifty amid the continued slide
gist: Sensex -0.32% at 78,387.3, below VWAP 78,626.9, but well off the -1.17%/-1.38% declines in Nifty/Bank Nifty — the divergence noted at 12:25 persists as financials keep underperforming.

headline: ONGC Q1 FY27 consolidated profit jumps ~53% YoY to ₹13,678 cr on higher crude realizations; stock near-flat
gist: ONGC's Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT rose ~53% YoY to ₹13,678 cr (profit attributable to owners +46% YoY) on sharply higher Apr-Jun crude realizations. Stock barely reacted (₹241.4 vs prev close ₹242.0, ~flat) as broader RBI-eve market caution dominated. Source: Business Standard/PSU Connect.

headline: Nifty, Bank Nifty extend RBI-eve slide to fresh session lows; WTI crude spikes to a fresh session high
gist: Nifty -1.19% at 24,479.70 (day range 24,428.2-24,666.65), below VWAP 24,541.18, breaking further through the 24,506-24,524 demand zone already flagged twice this session. Bank Nifty -1.26% at 57,512.25, also below VWAP, low 1/5 of range. Sensex -0.44% at 78,293.63, still holding up relatively better than Nifty/Bank Nifty. WTI crude spiked sharply in the last ~15min from ~$80.78 to a fresh session high $81.76 (last $81.69, +1.68%), above VWAP $81.00; demand 80.40-80.55 held twice on the way up. Gold $4,114.70 (+0.59%) and Silver $59.13 (+2.20%) little changed, both off session highs. Nat gas $2.763 (-0.65%), soft on ample storage.

headline: UPDATE: Bank Nifty prints a fresh session low as RBI-eve selloff deepens into the close
gist: Bank Nifty -1.30% at 57,492.75, fresh session low 57,352.65 (below the 57,426.6 low flagged at 13:21), below VWAP 57,593.6; demand 57,380-57,430 defended repeatedly. Nifty -1.26% at 24,463.45, back near its 24,428 low, below VWAP 24,529.4. Sensex -0.47% at 78,266.37, still holding up relatively better.

headline: UPDATE: WTI crude extends its spike to a fresh session high $82.32 before easing to $81.77
gist: WTI printed a fresh session high of $82.32 (+2.5%, above the $81.76 high flagged at 14:23) as the Iran/Hormuz supply-risk narrative continued to dominate, before easing to $81.77 (+1.78%); capped twice at 82.05-82.32, above VWAP $81.32. Demand 80.40-80.65 held earlier in the session.

headline: Gold, Silver ease off their session highs into the afternoon
gist: Gold $4,102.90 (+0.30%, off session high $4,129.60), Silver $58.91 (+1.82%, off session high $59.40 flagged at 13:21) - both below VWAP and off best levels but still higher on the day as the earlier pop fades.

headline: UPDATE: WTI crashes over $5 from fresh high $82.33 to session low $76.58, settling $77.92 (-3.0%) as Bessent flags imminent Hormuz deal
gist: WTI spiked to a fresh session high $82.33 (supply capped 82.03-82.28 three times) then crashed to $76.58 before steadying near $77.92, below VWAP $79.70 and prior close $80.34, after Treasury Sec. Bessent said a Hormuz deal is possible 'today or tomorrow', reversing the earlier Iran-risk-driven rally.

headline: Iran's FM: Oman talks aim for a temporary Hormuz shipping arrangement 'where Iran is dominant', still denies direct US talks
gist: Iran's Foreign Ministry said Oman-mediated talks aim for a temporary 1-3 month arrangement over Strait of Hormuz shipping routes, while continuing to deny direct US talks despite Treasury Sec. Bessent's claim a deal could land 'today or tomorrow'.

headline: UPDATE: Silver rips to a fresh session high $59.77 (+3.3%), sharply outpacing gold's +0.87% gain
gist: Silver $59.77 (+3.30%), fresh session high, above VWAP $59.25, resuming its rally beyond the 59.40/59.77 highs flagged earlier as the dollar stays soft. Gold $4,126.10 (+0.87%), above VWAP $4,119.28, upper-mid range.

headline: UPDATE: Nat gas extends slide to $2.70 (-2.84%), near session low, as cooler US weather forecasts cut AC-demand outlook
gist: Nat gas $2.702 (-2.84%), below VWAP $2.729, near the session low $2.697, extending its slide as updated forecasts call for cooler temperatures across the central/eastern US, cutting expected air-conditioning demand; production remains near record highs.

headline: UPDATE: WTI breaks below Monday's $76.58 low to fresh session low $75.77 (-4.80%) as Trump's Iran strike stand-down and OPEC+'s confirmed Sept output hike deepen the Hormuz de-escalation selloff
gist: WTI $76.48 (-4.80%), fresh session low $75.77, below VWAP $78.39, breaking the $76.58 low flagged at 18:09 IST. Trump signaled confidence Hormuz will reopen soon while Iran denied direct US talks (Oman-mediated corridor talks continue); OPEC+ confirmed a +188kbd Sept hike completing the second of three cut-restoration packages. Supply zone 76.85-77.06 capping the bounce; demand held 75.77-76.25.

headline: UPDATE: Silver hits a fresh session high $60.24, sharply outpacing gold's +1.06% gain as the dollar softens
gist: Silver $59.64 (+3.08%), fresh session high $60.24 (topping the $59.77 high flagged at 18:09), above VWAP $59.59; demand 58.78-58.90 held, supply 60.01-60.24 capping. Gold $4,133.80 (+1.06%), above VWAP $4,128.48, upper half of range. Nat gas $2.664 (-4.21%), below VWAP $2.693, near session low on cooler-weather/ample-storage theme already flagged — no fresh driver.

headline: UPDATE: WTI slides to fresh session low $75.16 (-6.5% intraday), steadies near $75.9 as Bessent Hormuz deal talk and OPEC+ Sept hike keep pressure on
gist: WTI $75.87 (-5.56%), fresh session low $75.16 breaking the $75.77 low flagged at 21:02, below VWAP $77.85 and prior close $80.34. Demand held twice near 75.16-75.60, supply capping 76.20-76.32 on the recovery attempt.

headline: UPDATE: Silver rips to a fresh session high $60.29 (+4.1%), sharply outpacing gold as the dollar stays soft
gist: Silver $60.235 (+4.11%), fresh high $60.285 topping the $60.24 flagged at 21:02, above VWAP $59.68; demand held 59.60-59.80 twice. Gold $4,156.90 (+1.62%), fresh session high $4,163.80, above VWAP $4,131.87, on continued dollar softness and rate-cut positioning into Friday US jobs data.

headline: Nat gas holds soft near $2.67 (-3.85%), still pressured by ample storage and a cooler-weather outlook; no fresh driver
gist: Nat gas $2.674 (-3.85%), below VWAP $2.6885, largely unchanged from the $2.664 flagged at 21:02 — storage 6.4% above the 5-yr average and a cooler weather outlook continue to cap prices with no fresh catalyst.

headline: GIFT Nifty up 190pts eyeing gap-up as Wall St hits records, Asia surges on Hormuz hopes; RBI verdict due 10am
instrument: NIFTY 50 / SENSEX / BANK NIFTY / GLOBAL MARKETS
gist: First brief of the day (overnight/premarket). GIFT Nifty +0.76% at 24,743 signals a gap-up open. Wall St closed at fresh records Tue (S&P 500 +1.79% to 7,737, Dow +1.71% above 54,000 first time ever, Nasdaq +2.59% to 26,584.99) on Hormuz-deal hopes and AI-earnings strength. Asia followed through hard: Nikkei +2.66%, Kospi +4.51% (SK Hynix +7%, Samsung +4%, SoftBank +9%). Cash Nifty opened ~24,636-24,678 (+0.09%), faded from the opening high, below VWAP, lower-half of range — chop risk into RBI. Bank Nifty 57,878 (-0.05%), above VWAP, near session high. Sensex feed still delayed on Yahoo at open (last live print 78,428.95, Tue's close) — same issue as yesterday's first brief. RBI's 3-day MPC concludes today; Gov. Malhotra announces verdict 10am IST, presser 12pm; consensus (Business Standard poll) sees repo rate held at 5.25% for a 4th straight meeting.

headline: UPDATE: Bharti Airtel Q1 FY27 net profit jumps 37.3% YoY to ₹8,167cr, revenue +18.4% to ₹58,539cr, beats estimates
gist: Results now out (flagged as pending in yesterday's 09:24 IST brief). Bharti Airtel (Nifty's #2 weight, ~6.2%) posted Q1 FY27 consolidated net profit of ₹8,167.4cr (+37.3% YoY vs ₹5,947.9cr), revenue ₹58,539cr (+18.4% YoY), EBITDA margin 57.4%. India ARPU rose to ₹264 from ₹250 YoY on strong subscriber additions (+14.9mn to 681mn base). Stock closed Tue at ₹1,970.1 (day range ₹1,936-1,980); insider trading window stays closed until Aug 6. Source: Business Standard/Upstox.

headline: UPDATE: WTI extends slide to fresh multi-week low $74.24, below yesterday's $75.16 low, as Qatar drafts interim Hormuz proposal
gist: WTI $74.47-74.75 (-1.72% vs prev close $75.77), fresh session low $74.24 breaking below the $75.16 low flagged in yesterday's 23:02 IST brief, below VWAP $75.70. Qatar-mediated talks produced a draft interim proposal on reopening Strait of Hormuz shipping; both Washington and Tehran signalled progress overnight, extending oil's >10% two-day decline. Demand zone $75.10-75.40 (held ~5hrs) broken on the way down. Source: Bloomberg.

headline: UPDATE: Gold, Silver rip to fresh highs ($4,193.8 / $61.21) as dollar softens on firming Fed September rate-cut bets
gist: Gold $4,186.40 (+0.81% vs prev close $4,152.60), fresh session high $4,193.80, above VWAP, near session high. Silver $61.02 (+1.29% vs prev close $60.245), fresh session high $61.21 (topping the $60.29 high flagged at 23:02 IST yesterday), above VWAP $60.19, breaking the $60.00-60.15 resistance that had capped it for hours; demand zone $59.65-59.90 held repeatedly beforehand. NY Fed's Williams said inflation still on a gradual path lower but Fed would hike if pressures persist; markets nonetheless pared Fed hike bets and leaned into a softer-dollar, rate-cut-friendly tape overnight. Nat gas flat at $2.698 (+0.56%), no fresh driver, same cooler-weather/ample-storage theme as before. Source: Business Standard/CNBC.

headline: RBI MPC unanimously holds repo rate at 5.25% for 4th straight meeting, retains neutral stance
gist: RBI Governor Malhotra announced the MPC decision at 10am: repo rate held unchanged at 5.25% (4th consecutive pause), neutral stance retained. RBI cut FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.6% (from 6.9% in April) and raised FY27 CPI inflation forecast to 5.1% (from 4.6%) on higher energy pass-through. Decision was in line with consensus.

headline: 10Y G-sec yield jumps 8bps to 6.74% on RBI's hawkish inflation revision; Bank Nifty pares gains
gist: India's 10Y government bond yield rose 8bps from 6.65% to 6.74% immediately after the RBI verdict, reflecting the hawkish read from the raised FY27 CPI forecast (5.1%) and cut GDP forecast (6.6%). Bank Nifty -0.12% at 57,836.8 (day range 57,654.7-57,929.7), below VWAP 57,867.2, upper-half of range; demand held twice at 57,835-57,850, supply capped 57,895-57,920. Nifty -0.03% at 24,608.6, below VWAP, lower-third of range. Sensex +0.45% at 78,784.2, still outperforming Nifty/Bank Nifty as in prior briefs.

headline: WTI holds near $75, extending 10%+ weekly slide as Qatar's draft Hormuz proposal fuels de-escalation hopes
gist: WTI $75.15 (-0.82% vs prev close $75.77), day range $74.50-75.21, above VWAP $74.91, near day highs -- a modest bounce off the sub-$74.24 multi-week low flagged in the 09:21 IST brief. Qatar's draft interim proposal on reopening the Strait of Hormuz continues to cap upside; Bessent said a deal could land 'today or tomorrow'.

headline: Gold, Silver ease off overnight highs but hold strong gains on soft dollar, Fed rate-cut bets
gist: Gold $4,192.10 (+0.95% vs prev close $4,152.60), below VWAP $4,195.27, off the $4,193.80 session high flagged at 09:21 IST. Silver $61.02 (+1.28% vs prev close $60.245), below VWAP $61.08, pulled back from the $61.21 fresh high flagged at 09:21 IST. Both still firm on soft-dollar, Fed-rate-cut positioning; no new catalyst since last brief. Nat gas flat at $2.70 (+0.75%), tight range, no fresh driver.

headline: UPDATE: Gold, Silver rip to fresh session highs ($4,212.60 / $61.54) as the dollar stays soft
gist: Gold $4,210.60 (+1.40% vs prev close $4,152.60), fresh session high $4,212.60 topping the $4,193.80 high flagged at 09:21 IST, above VWAP, near day high. Silver $61.51 (+2.09% vs prev close $60.245), fresh session high $61.54 topping the $61.21 high flagged at 09:21 IST, above VWAP; demand zone $60.94-61.04 defended repeatedly beforehand. Both extending the soft-dollar, Fed Sept rate-cut-bet rally. Source: Yahoo Finance.

headline: Nifty, Sensex hold modest post-RBI gains while Bank Nifty softens further on the hawkish CPI revision
gist: Nifty +0.08% at 24,633.50 (day range 24,562.20-24,677.60), above VWAP, upper-mid range. Sensex +0.57% at 78,872.30, above VWAP, continuing to outpace Nifty/Bank Nifty as flagged since midday Aug 4. Bank Nifty -0.22% at 57,778.50 (day range 57,593.90-57,929.69), below VWAP, faded further from the -0.12% flagged at 10:16 IST as the RBI's hawkish CPI revision keeps weighing on financials. Source: NSE/BSE.

headline: WTI eases back to $74.77, still capped below Monday's close as Hormuz de-escalation and OPEC+ hike weigh
gist: WTI $74.77 (-1.32% vs prev close $75.77), below VWAP $75.02, low 1/3 of day range $74.24-76.06 -- drifting back down after the modest bounce to $75.15 flagged at 10:16 IST. Qatar's draft Hormuz shipping proposal and OPEC+'s confirmed Sept output hike remain the dominant bearish drivers; no fresh number since the 09:21 IST multi-week-low flag. Source: Yahoo Finance.

headline: UPDATE: Nifty flips negative, Bank Nifty extends slide to fresh post-RBI low; Sensex the lone holdout
gist: Nifty -0.15% at 24,578.70 (range 24,561.50-24,677.60), below VWAP 24,605.19, erasing early post-RBI/crude-relief gains. Bank Nifty -0.39% at 57,683.10, fresh session low 57,593.90, below VWAP 57,783.38; demand 57,620-57,650 held twice. Sensex +0.23% at 78,605.66, below VWAP but still the lone index holding gains.

headline: UPDATE: Gold rips to a fresh session high $4,237.80 (+1.97%), Silver outpaces at fresh high $62.01 (+2.84%)
gist: Gold $4,234.60 (+1.97%), fresh session high $4,237.80, above VWAP $4,214.74; demand 4,220-4,226 defended three times on the climb. Silver $61.95 (+2.84%), fresh high $62.01, above VWAP $61.55, extending the dollar-softness rally beyond the $61.54 high flagged at 11:18.

headline: Govt exercises LIC OFS green-shoe option after 3.32x institutional demand; retail bidding opens today
gist: Government exercising the full green-shoe option in its LIC OFS (up to 6.5% stake) after the institutional portion was oversubscribed 3.32x on day one. Retail investors and eligible employees can bid today (Aug 5) at a floor price of Rs 382, effective Rs 373.10 after the retail discount. Source: BusinessToday/Upstox.
